digest.component_or_area: review-bot shutdown lifespan and reconciler drain
propositions: The app.py lifespan drain waits only on queue.join() for webhook-queued reviews, not on in-flight reconciler reviews awaited inline in reconcile_once, leaving reconciler work unprotected.
When the webhook queue empties, queue.join() returns immediately and reconcile_loop tasks are cancelled within ~10s shutdown_cancel_seconds(), abandoning multi-minute backfill reviews mid-execution.
Any container stop outside the autodeploy path (manual restart, host reboot, rollback) kills in-flight reconciler reviews with effectively no drain protection.
The reconcile_loop must not start new reviews once shutdown begins, to prevent the drain deadline from extending indefinitely.
The drain must cover both webhook-queue reviews and in-flight reconciler reviews within a single shared shutdown_drain_seconds() budget, respecting the existing stop_grace_period relationship.
